question: Can a read-only corrective audit establish independently verifiable replay, replacement, event-coverage and scientific-visualization evidence for the sealed Gate-1 range/teacher dataset?
method: Verify the sealed source dataset and M1R assets; reconstruct the frozen selector over exactly 80 train and 10 validation parents; recast every attempted frame through two new Open3D scenes; compare selected scans and teachers to sealed Zarr/manifest; preserve all rejected-candidate reasons; generate complete train-only sample, spatial-coverage and distribution figures.
baseline: The sealed source manifest, 90 Zarr shards and original per-world summaries are the immutable baseline; selected IDs/order, role quotas and rejected counts must reproduce exactly. There is no adaptive fallback.

user_authorization.scope: One corrective evidence-only Gate-1 execution over the sealed 80/10, 22500-cluster, 112500-frame dataset; no mutation, re-export or training.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: User replied 继续 after being shown the exact corrective audit purpose, 90-world scope, replay/rejection/visualization outputs, approximately 24-minute cost and <=1 GiB limit.

acceptance_criteria: The 12790-entry source dataset seal and 1001-entry M1R seal pass before execution, and the source dataset seal is unchanged after execution.
Exactly 80 train and 10 validation worlds, 22500 selected clusters and 112500 selected frames are audited; C10 and M-TARE reads remain zero.
Recreated selected cluster IDs and order exactly match the sealed manifest, exact per-role quotas remain unchanged, and exactly 61 rejected candidates have non-empty frame-level reasons.
All selected stored-to-scene-A and scene-A-to-scene-B valid masks are equal and range maximum differences are <=1e-6m.
All sealed objective targets, branch counts, headings, LOS and clearance values match recomputation; 634 junction and 575 terminal events remain covered.

Ten train-only pages simultaneously display range, invalid mask, teacher target/headings and LOS; ten train-only figures show spline/cluster spatial coverage; one train-only figure shows role, branch, valid and range distributions.
Complete within 3600 seconds and 1GiB with logs, metrics, JSONL evidence, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal; training/models/data mutation remain zero.
stop_conditions: Any source/tool/environment/seal, split, identity, count, replay, teacher, event, visualization, time or disk check fails.
Any source mutation, new world/seed/candidate, replacement-policy change, threshold change, data re-export, training or M-TARE modification is required.
expected_evidence: 112500-line replay_audit.jsonl, 61-line rejected_candidates.jsonl, 90 world metrics and aggregate summary.
Ten complete train sample pages, ten train spatial-coverage figures and one train distribution figure with machine-readable provenance in metrics.
Approved corrective Data Card/proposal, frozen source/tool/environment identities, raw log, source before/after seal audits, RUN_STATE and complete result SHA-256 manifest.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU-only Open3D replay in frozen E1+Zarr; no Gazebo, Isaac, GPU, data export or training.
